name: Load sample workspace and review categorized files
description: Verifies the sample action displays representative files and enables organization suggestions.
expected: Six sample files appear with categories and the Suggest organization button is enabled.

name: Filter the file list by category
description: Verifies the category controls show matching files without losing the workspace.
expected: Only image-category sample files are displayed and the Images filter is active.

name: Change a file's suggested folder
description: Verifies a user can override an AI or sample category using the folder selector.
steps: Change a file's folder selector to Other
expected: The selected file displays Other as its category and the workspace remains usable.

name: Handle unavailable local Ollama safely
description: Verifies that missing Ollama does not break the file organizer and provides fallback suggestions.
steps: Choose Suggest organization while Ollama is not connected
expected: The app remains usable, shows a message about filename-based suggestions, and does not upload or move files.
